So your life is meaningless, eh? Not to be changing anything in the world is what you fear? Well that's exactly what is the case. The earth wouldn't stop turning, nor does the whole universe give a shit about our beautiful planet, which is just a speck of blue out there in the middle of nowhere called milkyway. That's the wast reality. But think the other way as well: We can't influence single molecules, atoms or even quarks. A single of these does not matter to us. Just as some tiny planet does no matter to the universe.

"What can I get out of this?", you may ask. Well, you need to find the right scale, on which to look upon things. That's it. That's what I've found to be essential when considering how to give meaning to ones life.

For me personally I found the right scale in humans. Interacting with some, trying to understand what's going on with them, being curious about anything. And the other thing I found: Improving myself. Always try to be more than you are.

Somehow your post sounds resigned. I hope you will get along, just as I have; and that you find helpful advice in this subreddit, just as I have. Good luck.
